note: Modifier names and descriptions whose id names no banned concept but whose installed text does (a modifier is otherwise named by its id through the stem rows of tooltips.json). Terms come from the glossary: division = Host, factory = Workshop or Armoury, manpower = Levies, organisation = Cohesion, plane = Flier, convoy = Merchant Fleet.
